requirements.statement: Household members can sign in to the application

criteria.must: A household member can sign in through the platform's sign-in flow
An unauthenticated visitor cannot view the shared expense data

requirements.statement: A household member can quickly add an expense with an amount, category, date, and optional note

criteria.must: A household member can create an expense with amount, category, and date
A household member can add an optional note to an expense
Creating an expense without a required field (amount, category, or date) is rejected

requirements.statement: Either household member can edit or delete any expense in the shared ledger, regardless of who entered it

criteria.must: A household member can edit an expense entered by the other household member
A household member can delete an expense entered by the other household member

requirements.statement: Every expense is assigned to a category

criteria.must: An expense cannot be created without a category
An expense's category can be changed after creation

requirements.statement: Household members can create, rename, and remove expense categories

criteria.must: A household member can create a new category
A household member can rename an existing category
A household member can remove a category

requirements.statement: Household members can view total expenditure for today, the current week, and the current month

criteria.must: The dashboard shows a total for today's expenses
The dashboard shows a total for the current calendar week (Monday-Sunday)
The dashboard shows a total for the current calendar month

requirements.statement: Household members can see a breakdown of spending by category for a selected period

criteria.must: A per-category spending breakdown is shown for a selected period
The per-category breakdown updates when a new expense is added to that category

requirements.statement: Household members can set a spending limit for each category

criteria.must: A household member can set a monthly spending limit on a category
A household member can update an existing category's spending limit

requirements.statement: Household members can see how much of each category's limit has been used for the current period, including when it is over limit

criteria.must: Each category shows the amount used against its limit for the current calendar month
A category whose spending exceeds its limit is visibly flagged as over limit
Category limit usage resets at the start of each calendar month

requirements.statement: A household member can log an expense in a foreign currency and have it converted to the household's home currency for reporting

criteria.must: An expense can be entered in a currency other than the household's home currency
A foreign-currency expense is converted to the home currency and included in totals and category usage in that currency
The original amount and currency entered remain visible on the expense
